title: Nuzlocke Tracker
subtitle: Log the first Pokémon you meet in each area, keep your team, box and graveyard in order, and pick your run up where you left off.
metaTitle: Nuzlocke Tracker: encounters, team, graveyard and level caps
metaDescription: A free Nuzlocke tracker: pick your game, log the first encounter in each area, mark the fallen, and see your team's weaknesses and the next level cap. Saved in your browser, with share links.
credit: Each game's sources are listed on its page. Types and type charts from Pokémon Showdown's data; pictures: Pokémon HOME renders from PokéAPI. Pokémon is © Nintendo, Game Freak and Creatures.
